```{r}
# Load packages
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here, glmmTMB, DHARMa, performance, broom.mixed, car, dplyr, emmeans, ggeffects, scales, patchwork)

```


```{r}
# Load Data
data <- read.csv(here("data", "exp1_data.csv"))

```

```{r}
# Factorise IDs + treatment
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment),
    Tank_ID   = factor(Tank_ID),
    Fish_ID   = factor(Fish_ID),
    Batch     = factor(Batch),
    Trial     = factor(Trial),
    Arena     = factor(Arena)
  )

```

```{r}
# Create a subset excluding fish not came out
# Remove fish that did not come out of shelter
data_subset <- subset(data, notes != "not came out")

# Check sample size
nrow(data)        # 160
nrow(data_subset) # 126
```
```{r}
data$emerged <- ifelse(data$notes == "not came out", 0, 1)

emergence_probability_model <- glmmTMB(emerged ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1|Tank_ID),
        family = binomial,
        data = data)


summary(emergence_probability_model)
Anova(emergence_probability_model)

emm <- emmeans(emergence_probability_model, ~ Treatment)

summary(emm, type = "response")

```


```{r}
summary(data$Distance_moved)
summary(data$Time_not_moving)
summary(data$Time_shelter)

hist(data$Distance_moved)
hist(data$Time_not_moving)
hist(data$Time_shelter)

```



```{r}
#Distance_moved
#Family tweedie
m2_distance_moved <- glmmTMB(Distance_moved ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1 | Tank_ID),
  data = data,
  family = tweedie(link = "log"))

summary(m2_distance_moved)

# Diagnosis
res_m2_distance_moved <- simulateResiduals(m2_distance_moved)
plot(res_m2_distance_moved)

testDispersion(res_m2_distance_moved)
testZeroInflation(res_m2_distance_moved)
testOutliers(res_m2_distance_moved)

Anova(m2_distance_moved)

```


```{r}
# Plotting Distance_moved
# 1) Ensure treatment order
data$Treatment <- factor(
  data$Treatment,
  levels = c("Control", "low", "high")
)

# 2) Fit Tweedie model
m2_distance_moved <- glmmTMB(
  Distance_moved ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1 | Tank_ID),
  data = data,
  family = tweedie(link = "log")
)

summary(m2_distance_moved)

# 3) Get marginal means on the response scale
emm_dist_df <- as.data.frame(
  emmeans(m2_distance_moved, ~ Treatment, type = "response")
)

print(emm_dist_df)

# 4) Standardise column names
cn <- names(emm_dist_df)

mean_col  <- dplyr::first(cn[cn %in% c("response", "rate", "emmean")])
lower_col <- dplyr::first(cn[grepl("^lower\\.CL$|^asymp\\.LCL$|^LCL$|^lower$", cn)])
upper_col <- dplyr::first(cn[grepl("^upper\\.CL$|^asymp\\.UCL$|^UCL$|^upper$", cn)])

if (is.na(mean_col) || is.na(lower_col) || is.na(upper_col)) {
  stop("Could not identify mean/CI columns in emmeans output. Run names(emm_dist_df).")
}

emm_dist_df <- emm_dist_df %>%
  mutate(Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "low", "high"))) %>%
  rename(
    mean  = !!mean_col,
    lower = !!lower_col,
    upper = !!upper_col
  )

# 5) Palettes
pastel_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#A8D5BA",
  "low"     = "#F9E79F",
  "high"    = "#F5B7B1"
)

dark_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#2E8B57",
  "low"     = "#C9A227",
  "high"    = "#B22222"
)

# 6) Plot on original distance scale
p_distance <- ggplot() +
  geom_violin(
    data = data,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = Distance_moved, fill = Treatment),
    alpha = 0.20,
    colour = NA,
    trim = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = data,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = Distance_moved, colour = Treatment),
    width = 0.18,
    alpha = 0.55,
    size = 2
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = emm_dist_df,
    aes(x = Treatment, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, colour = Treatment),
    width = 0.25,
    linewidth = 1.3
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = emm_dist_df,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = mean, fill = Treatment),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    stroke = 1.2,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pastel_cols) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dark_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = scales::pseudo_log_trans(base = 10),
  breaks = c(0, 1000, 10000, 50000),
  labels = scales::comma) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Fluoxetine treatment",
    y = "Distance moved"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p_distance)

ggsave(
  filename = here("figures", "distance_travelled.pdf"),
  plot = p_distance,
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  filename = here("figures", "distance_travelled.jpg"),
  plot = p_distance,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)

```



```{r}
#Time_shelter

data_moved <- subset(data, Time_shelter > 0 & Time_shelter < 1200)
data_moved$prop_shelter <- data_moved$Time_shelter / 1200

beta <-glmmTMB(
  prop_shelter ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1 | Tank_ID),
  family = beta_family(link="logit"),
  data = data_moved
)

summary(beta)

res_beta <- simulateResiduals(beta)
plot(res_beta)

testDispersion(res_beta)
testZeroInflation(res_beta)
testOutliers(res_beta)

Anova(beta)

```


```{r}
# Plotting Time_shelter

# 1) Ensure treatment order
data$Treatment <- factor(
  data$Treatment,
  levels = c("Control", "low", "high")
)

# 2) Create log-transformed shelter time
# log1p handles zeros safely
data$logTS <- log1p(data$Time_shelter)

# 3) Fit model
m_logTS <- glmmTMB(
  logTS ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1 | Tank_ID),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = data
)

summary(m_logTS)

# 4) Get marginal means on the LOG scale
emm_logTS_df <- as.data.frame(emmeans(m_logTS, ~ Treatment))

# 5) Back-transform to original time scale
cn <- names(emm_logTS_df)

mean_col  <- if ("emmean" %in% cn) "emmean" else stop("Can't find emmean column")
lower_col <- dplyr::first(cn[grepl("^lower\\.CL$|^asymp\\.LCL$|^LCL$|^lower$", cn)])
upper_col <- dplyr::first(cn[grepl("^upper\\.CL$|^asymp\\.UCL$|^UCL$|^upper$", cn)])

emm_logTS_df <- emm_logTS_df %>%
  mutate(Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "low", "high"))) %>%
  rename(mean_log = !!mean_col, lower_log = !!lower_col, upper_log = !!upper_col) %>%
  mutate(
    mean  = exp(mean_log) - 1,
    lower = exp(lower_log) - 1,
    upper = exp(upper_log) - 1
  )

# 6) Palettes
pastel_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#A8D5BA",
  "low"     = "#F9E79F",
  "high"    = "#F5B7B1"
)

dark_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#2E8B57",
  "low"     = "#C9A227",
  "high"    = "#B22222"
)

# 7) Plot on original scale
p_shelter <- ggplot() +
  geom_violin(
    data = data,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = Time_shelter, fill = Treatment),
    alpha = 0.20, colour = NA, trim = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = data,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = Time_shelter, colour = Treatment),
    width = 0.18, alpha = 0.55, size = 2
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    data = emm_logTS_df,
    aes(x = Treatment, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, colour = Treatment),
    width = 0.25, linewidth = 1.3
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = emm_logTS_df,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = mean, fill = Treatment),
    shape = 21, size = 5, stroke = 1.2, colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pastel_cols) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = dark_cols) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    x = "Fluoxetine treatment",
    y = "Time spent in shelter"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here("figures", "shelter.pdf"),
  plot = p_shelter,
  width = 6,
  height = 5
)

ggsave(
  filename = here("figures", "shelter.jpg"),
  plot = p_shelter,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 600
)

```


```{r}
## Time_freezing

  data = data,
  family = tweedie(link = "log"))

summary(m1_time_not_moving)

# Diagnosis
res_m1_time_not_moving <- simulateResiduals(m1_time_not_moving)

# Anova of the model
```

```{r}
## Time_not_moving (freezing time)

# 1) Ensure treatment order
data$Treatment <- factor(
  data$Treatment,
  levels = c("Control", "low", "high")
)

# 2) Fit Tweedie model
m1_time_not_moving <- glmmTMB(
  Time_not_moving ~ Treatment + Body_mass + (1 | Tank_ID),
  data = data,
  family = tweedie(link = "log")
)

summary(m1_time_not_moving)

# 3) Estimated marginal means on response scale
emm_freezing <- as.data.frame(
  emmeans(m1_time_not_moving, ~ Treatment, type = "response")
)

print(emm_freezing)

# 4) Standardise column names
cn <- names(emm_freezing)

mean_col  <- dplyr::first(cn[cn %in% c("response", "rate", "emmean")])
lower_col <- dplyr::first(cn[grepl("^lower\\.CL$|^asymp\\.LCL$|^LCL$|^lower$", cn)])
upper_col <- dplyr::first(cn[grepl("^upper\\.CL$|^asymp\\.UCL$|^UCL$|^upper$", cn)])

if (is.na(mean_col) || is.na(lower_col) || is.na(upper_col)) {
  stop("Could not identify mean/CI columns in emmeans output. Run names(emm_freezing).")
}

emm_freezing <- emm_freezing %>%
  mutate(Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Control", "low", "high"))) %>%
  rename(
    mean  = !!mean_col,
    lower = !!lower_col,
    upper = !!upper_col
  )

# 5) Colour palettes
pastel_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#A8D5BA",
  "low"     = "#F9E79F",
  "high"    = "#F5B7B1"
)

dark_cols <- c(
  "Control" = "#2E8B57",
  "low"     = "#C9A227",
  "high"    = "#B22222"
)

# 6) Plot
p_freezing <- ggplot() +

    alpha = 0.20,
    colour = NA,

    data = emm_freezing,
    aes(x = Treatment, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, colour = Treatment),
    width = 0.25,
    linewidth = 1.3
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = emm_freezing,
    aes(x = Treatment, y = mean, fill = Treatment),
    shape = 21,
    size = 5,
    stroke = 1.2,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pastel_cols) +
```

```{r}
#Figure 1
# Remove repeated x-axis titles from individual plots
p_distance_clean <- p_distance +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Distance moved (cm)") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

p_freezing_clean <- p_freezing +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Time freezing (s)") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

p_shelter_clean <- p_shelter +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Time spent in shelter (s)") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# Combine plots
figure_behaviour <- (
  p_distance_clean + p_freezing_clean + p_shelter_clean
) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    caption = "Fluoxetine treatment"
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

figure_behaviour

ggsave(
  filename = here("figures", "behaviour_figure.pdf"),
  plot = figure_behaviour,
  width = 12,
  height = 4.5
)

ggsave(
  filename = here("figures", "behaviour_figure.jpg"),
  plot = figure_behaviour,
  width = 12,
  height = 4.5,
  dpi = 600
)

```
